versions.changelog:
- Added a prominent Privacy & Data Security Warning section advising users about local caching and risks with sensitive data.
- Clarified when to use the skill, highlighting explicit/compression-heavy scenarios and warning against routine or sensitive-data use.
- Expanded Pitfalls and usage notes to stress privacy implications and local cache management.
- Removed the outdated skill-card.md documentation file.

**Initial release of headroom-token-compression.**

- Compresses tool outputs, logs, RAG chunks, and files sent to LLMs, saving 20–95% tokens.
- Multiple integration modes: command-line wrapping, proxy, MCP, and Python library.
- Works with major coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, etc.).
- Includes installation verification commands and real-time dashboard.
- Supports optional model output compression and learns verbosity preferences.
- Keeps all processing and cache local for privacy.
